title: Krumpin'
subtitle: Fight phase: pile in, pick a weapon, swing

bullets: Da Fight phase opens wiv [b]Pile In[/b] — every engaged unit may shuffle 3" closer. Skip it wiv [b]End Pile In[/b].
Click a unit in [b]UNITS THAT CAN FIGHT[/b] to activate it. Units dat charged swing first.
In da attack panel: pick [b]one[/b] melee weapon, pick da target, [b]Weapon to Target[/b], den [b]Fight![/b]
Da dice dock rolls it out — [b]Fast Roll ⏩[/b] does da lot, [b]Done ✔[/b] finishes da activation.
You an' da enemy alternate activations till everyone's swung. Last lesson: Runnin' da Show.

prompt.text: Da Boyz made it in — now dey get to krump. Every engaged unit fights once, an' units dat [b]charged[/b] go first. It starts wiv a [b]Pile In[/b] step for everyone.

prompt.kbm: Pile In lets every engaged unit move 3" closer to da enemy. Yer Boyz are already in contact, so just hit [b]End Pile In[/b].
prompt.pad: Yer Boyz are already in contact — just press {menu}, da bar calls it [b]End Pile In[/b]. Or {dpad} ▼ lands right on da button, den {a}.

hint.text: Clickin' da unit row would let ya drag models 3" first — not needed here.

prompt.kbm: Click [b]Boyz[/b] under UNITS THAT CAN FIGHT. Dey charged, so dey swing before da Custodes do.
prompt.pad: {dpad} ▼ walks da fight panel onto da [b]Boyz[/b] row — {a} presses it. Dey charged, so dey swing first.

hint.text: Da list only shows units in engagement range — dat's who can fight.

prompt.kbm: Each model fights wiv [b]one[/b] melee weapon. Pick a weapon in da list, click da [b]Custodian Guard[/b] target, hit [b]Weapon to Target[/b], den [b]Fight![/b]
prompt.pad: Da attack panel takes its own controls: {dpad} ▲▼ picks da weapon, ◀▶ picks da target, {a} assigns 'em, den {menu} for [b]Fight![/b]

hint.text: Da panel shows expected damage per weapon — da Power klaw hits hardest but da Choppa gets more swings.

prompt.kbm: Same dice dock as shootin': [b]Fast Roll ⏩[/b] rolls hits, wounds an' saves in one go (or step frough wiv da big button). Finish wiv [b]Done ✔[/b].
prompt.pad: Da dock starts on [b]Roll to Wound ▶[/b] — {dpad} ▼ drops onto [b]Fast Roll ⏩[/b], den {a}. Clear any save cards, den [b]Done ✔[/b].

hint.text: Da big dock button always says what's next — keep pressin' it till it says Done.

prompt.kbm: Da enemy gets deir swings too — dat's alternatin' activation. Hit da big red button to end da phase; if anyone ain't swung yet da game warns ya first — confirm wiv [b]End Fight Phase[/b].
prompt.pad: Da enemy swings back — dat's alternatin' activation. Press {menu} to end da phase, den confirm [b]End Fight Phase[/b] if it warns ya.
